title: Aaj rukhsat ho rhi hai Tumse zehra Ya Ali
body:
Alwida Fatema (3)
Haye Baad baba ke jo guzri wo Musibat sunlo
Ya ali fatema zehra ki wasiyat sunlo
Aaj rukhsat ho rhi hai Tumse zehra Ya Ali(3)
Parda e shab mein meri mayyat uthana Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat........
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Pasliya todi gai kaise ye batlaungi mai
Hashr ke maidaa'n mein bhi is haal mein aaungi mai
Haath pehlu se na tum mera hatana Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj rukhsat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo musibat aap ne achcha hua dekhi nahi
Ab mai sidhe haath se tasbih padh sakti nahi
Aisa kunfuz ne hai mara taziyana Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj rukhsat....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haye....
Kehti hai zainab ye mujhse dekhkar chehra mera
Aapke rukhsaar par ye neel hai kaisa pada
Are
Maine khaya hai tamacha, Mat batana ya ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Taziyane ki aziyyat ka uthana ek taraf
Wo tamache, qatle mohsin, dar jalana ek taraf
Sabse mushkil tha magar darbaar jana ya ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jab meri talqeen padhna yaad kar lena zara
Dar ke girne se mera baazu bhi hai toota hua
Mere shano ko zara dhire hilana ya ali
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haye.....
Chahe aajaye qayamat mujhse ye waada karo
Jab talak maula mere shabbir ki marzi na ho
Are
Tab talak mera janaza mat uthana ya ali.....
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jab se aayi hu palat kar fikr hai mujhko yehi
Mai to parde mein gai fir bhi zaeefa ho gayi
Berida darbaar hai zainab ko jana ya ali....
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat......
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Karbala mein jab mere mazloom par khanjar chale
Pyaas k aalam me wo ghazi ko jab aawaaz de
Mai bhi aaungi waha par tum bhi aana ya ali.....
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.....
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Haye...
Haath pehlu pr rakhe boli takallum fatema
Mai dua krti hu tum aamin keh dena zara
Jald aaye mere Mahdi ka zamana ya ali.....
Ya ali..............
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruksat.......
